# ts23d — TypeScript to 3D

> @developerz.ai/ts23d (TypeScript to 3D) — a free, deterministic 3D asset generator driven by coding agents. Assets are TypeScript modules (never JSON) built with a DSL: `defineAsset({ name, kind, real, sources, budget, build(ctx) })`, where `build` adds named, pivoted, animatable parts from primitives (`box`, `lathe`, `cylinder`, `prism`, `beam`, `planar`) or from SVG drawings written as text (`extrudeSvg`, `latheSvg`, `visualHull` front/side silhouettes), places detail with `place`/`merge`, composes other assets with `ctx.use`, and gates detail on `ctx.lod`. It compiles to glTF/GLB for any engine (Unity, Unreal, Godot, three.js, Babylon) — ts23d generates assets only, the engine is yours — (3 LODs, one shared trim-sheet material, baked motion), fails a QA gate on floating parts, budget overruns and wrong real-world proportions, and renders a zero-GPU six-view contact-sheet PNG so a vision-capable agent can check its own work. The CLI needs Bun; the library imports under Node ≥ 22. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Status 0.x: stubs (`photoMatch`, `silhouetteIoU`, `localGenerator`, `kubeezImages`) throw T3D_NOT_IMPLEMENTED with the roadmap slice that builds them.

## Offline (inside your project)
The npm package ships the docs, skills, recipe sources and examples, versioned with the code — read them without internet (As of 2026-11: recipe `out/` renders, PNGs, tests and source maps are not in the tarball; read those on GitHub):
- `node_modules/@developerz.ai/ts23d/CLAUDE.md` — rules and the loop (the repo's `AGENTS.md` is a symlink to it and is not shipped)
- `node_modules/@developerz.ai/ts23d/docs/` — DSL, IR, materials, agent loop, QA, kinds, decisions, roadmap
- `node_modules/@developerz.ai/ts23d/recipes/<name>/` — idiomatic recipes, each with its research dossier (`README.md`); committed hero + contact sheet live in the GitHub repo under `recipes/<name>/out/`
- `node_modules/@developerz.ai/ts23d/.claude/skills/author-recipe/SKILL.md` — copy into your `.claude/skills/`

## The workflow
The human names a thing ("Tiger I, mid-production 1943"). The agent researches specs and real photos into `recipes/<name>/README.md` (every number sourced), writes `recipes/<name>/<name>.ts` (in your project: `assets/<name>.ts`) with `sources` + `real.measures` from that dossier, compiles until QA PASS (budget, surface contact, clashes, proportions ±5%, measures ±2%), renders the six-view contact sheet, looks at it, adds LOD-gated detail, and iterates.

## Programmatic (no CLI)
`t3d` is optional: `compile` → `runQa` → `toGlb` / `contactSheet` / `paintTrimSheet` are plain functions returning bytes. Runnable script: `examples/build-with-bun.ts` (also in the npm package).
- [Tuning](docs/idea/20-tuning.md): `t3d tune <recipe> [--evals N] [--seed s]` fits `tune.params` (read with `ctx.tuned`) to silhouette/measures/art/budget objectives by CMA-ES offline and writes `tune.json`, `tune-report.md`, `tune-strip.png`; builds read the committed numbers.
- Faces: `recipes/_lib/face` warps a committed CC0 base head (MakeHuman hm08, pinned) to ~40 code-set landmarks with `warpTPS` / `tpsWarp` (thin-plate spline, `@developerz.ai/ts23d/primitives`); race presets (human, orc, elf, dwarf, goblin) are numbers. Demo `recipes/face_demo`: the code is the brain, the base mesh is the face.
- [Import](docs/idea/21-import.md): `importGlb(source, opts)` (reader bounds and caps; shipped) brings a licence-pinned GLB (scan, CC0 base mesh) in as a part: cleaned, axis-fixed, `simplify` per LOD (ADR 011), `bakeNormals`, one trim-sheet material by default. Demo `recipes/import_demo`.
- [AI finish](docs/idea/22-ai-finish.md): `t3d finish <recipe> --endpoint URL --prompt "…"` projects model-painted views onto LOD0 as one texture layer, masked per part; geometry, names and motion unchanged; QA for palette drift and mask leaks. Demo `recipes/finish_demo`.
- [Real data](docs/idea/23-real-data.md): `@developerz.ai/ts23d/data` — `bun run data wikidata <QID>` → `realFrom`, `bun run data dem --centre lat,lon --size m` → `terrainFromDEM`; offline builds, sha256-pinned. Demo `recipes/real_valley`.

- [Author-recipe skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/.claude/skills/author-recipe/SKILL.md): the closed loop, step by step, with a skeleton

## DSL and concepts
- [The DSL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/02-dsl.md): defineAsset, ctx API, composition, determinism
- [IR, units, axes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/03-ir.md)
- [Materials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/04-materials.md): trim sheet, palettes, generator, image sources (kubeez.com)
- [Agent loop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/05-agent-loop.md): contact sheet layout, iteration
- [QA gates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/06-qa.md)
- [What fits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/07-what-fits.md): hard-surface vs organic; sculpted stylised characters and terrain today; realistic creatures via local-GPU adapters
- [Kinds](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/idea/09-kinds.md): buildings, vehicles, vessels, vegetation, scenes

## Reference
- [Public API barrel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/src/index.ts)
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/architecture/errors.md): every T3D_* with cause and fix
- [Module tiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/architecture/README.md)
- [glTF capabilities](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/architecture/gltf-capabilities.md): every extension, skins, physics drafts; what ts23d writes
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/plans/roadmap.md): shipped vs planned
- [Releases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/changelog/README.md): every version with its one-sentence summary, a page each (changes, diff, npm link); full log in CHANGELOG.md
- [Decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/docs/decisions/): why TS not JSON, why one material, why CPU renders
- [Example recipe: Tiger I](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/recipes/tiger_1/tiger_1.ts)
- [Reference dossier template](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/developerz-ai/ts23d/main/recipes/README.md)

- Parts kit: search recipes/_parts/README.md before writing geometry; definePart (docs/idea/14-parts.md).

- Playbooks: docs/playbooks/README.md — class-by-class guidance (vehicles, buildings, props, nature, characters) from a name to sourced specs, part tree, motion, QA.
- Art as text: docs/idea/16-art-as-text.md — art principles as measurable definitions, DSL words and checks.

- Lettering: `text(str, { font })` — 5 × 7 pixel (`'5x7'`, `'block'`, Latin + Cyrillic) or smooth Hershey stroke faces `'sans'`, `'serif'`, `'script'`, `'gothic'` (ASCII) with `weight`, `segments` (pick from `ctx.lod`), `cap`, kerning; flush or raised `depth`; `measureText`. Specimen: `recipes/type_specimen`.

- Finishes and optics: lacquered paint (clearcoat), glass/ice/liquid/jelly (transmission, ior, volume), sheen, anisotropy, iridescence; `--profile unreal|unity|godot|rt|web` (docs/idea/02-dsl.md).

- Sound: `sound.impact|engine|mechanism|ui` (`@developerz.ai/ts23d/audio`) — deterministic WAVs from material, size, cylinders/RPM, part motion; positional `KHR_audio_emitter` (docs/idea/17-sound.md).

- Weathering: `weather()` — seeded, geometry-driven rust streaks, chips, dust, moss, mud, bleach, dents, sag with `where` selectors and `amount` coverage measured into the manifest; QA `weather` (docs/idea/18-weathering.md).

## Optional

- kubeez.com — recommended for reference/concept images and texture sources
